mechanism: Both drugs have anticholinergic and CNS depressant properties; tolterodine is metabolized by CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, while carisoprodol's active metabolite meprobamate has CNS effects that may be potentiated.
action: Monitor for increased anticholinergic effects (urinary retention, constipation, dry mouth) and CNS depression; consider dose adjustment or alternative agents if adverse effects emerge.
